L45's size-only warning stands as the record.","buttons":"drawing - MODE at (37.4, 4.4) and RESET at (47.1, 4.4), legends under each, read from HIG Figure 8; both drawn with common/reset-button (4 mm recessed pinhole). The real MODE button is a raised rubber dome ~4 mm - closest library part used and the delta recorded here. Mode function per the HIG LED table footnote: 'The Mode button on the front panel allows switching between LNK/SPD and PoE status LEDs'.","chassis":"datasheet - 'Chassis (WxDxH) 1RU, 440 x 440 x 43.8 mm', weight 5.74 kg without FRU; the HIG Component Physical Information table repeats all three. 440 is the body between the ear folds, not a rack face: the HIG Space Clearance section separates 'The S6301-56STP width is 17.32 inches (44.0cm)' from the 'rack mount brackets suitable for 19 inch (48.3cm) wide racks', and the brackets are shipped loose (88 x 43 x 20 mm accessories, 8 M4 screws), so no ear extent needed subtracting. Depth 440 is likewise 'without the field replaceable units (FRUs)'; the fan handles project 25 mm and the PSU handles 38 mm beyond it (HIG Space Clearance), carried as relief on the FRU contracts rather than in the chassis depth.","front-layout":"drawing - HIG Figure 8 (Port Overview strip, 1385 x 141 px). GATE 1: the chassis in it measures 1378 x 137 px, aspect 10.06 against the datasheet's 10.05 (440/43.8) - 0.1% out, orthographic, measured at 3.13 px/mm. The 48 RJ45 jacks sit in four 6-column ganged blocks: the green jack LEDs (one per jack, read as column markers) give a within-block pitch of 13.9 mm and a block step of 87.5 mm (three independent steps of 87.49), first jack left edge at x 25.8. The SFP+ block's blue paint spans x 376.1-434.3, four columns on the std 14.25 pitch. Vent strip holes run x 84.6-436.5 in two rows. Vertical placements are the softer axis: the figure draws the jack rows schematically short, so the rows are set inside the measured shell band (y 11.9-38.3) with std/rj45-ganged's 11.0 height and the row split recorded here as drawing-constrained rather than measured.","jack-orientation":"photo - the front photograph and the datasheet front render, zoomed: the TOP RJ45 row has its keyway/tab UP and gold contacts toward the centre band (rotate 180 from the std default), the bottom row keyway-down; the SFP+ top row's bail nubs face the centre lamp band (rotate 180), bottom row default. Same mirrored-rows construction as the GL-8XEP and MX150 precedents.","jack-shells":"photo-measured - the four 12-port RJ45 blocks sit in SILVER ganged shells on the real unit (product render s6301-56stp-2-front.png); std/rj45-ganged draws the opening only, so each block's shell is a decor fill sized from its own placements plus a 1.1/1.2 mm flange, per the s9510-28dc silver-band precedent. Caught in review after the first pass drew the jacks dark-on-dark - the same defect the gl-8xep review found, and one no lint rule can see.","left-cluster":"drawing - HIG Figure 8 at 3.13 px/mm: silver bezel plate x 6.4-21.7, y 4.2-39.3 holding, top to bottom, the OOB management jack (two lamps above it), the USB-A port and the console jack ('IOIO' legend, HIG section 11: 'The console can be connected using the RJ45 port labelled IOIO'). The management and console jacks are drawn with std/rj45-ganged inside the shared plate decor because the plate is one piece of metal - the 16 mm single-port bezels would not fit the 35 mm stack. Management jack keyway-up (rotate 180), console keyway-down, both read from the figure's tab notches at zoom. The left-edge network pictogram and the USB/LED-mode/IOIOI icon row are approximated with the nearest glyphs, as the S9510-28DC does.","lifecycle":"searched 2026-08-28, 'UfiSpace S6301-56STP end of life' - no announcement; the vendor still lists the product (ufispace.com S6301-56STP product page) and it joined the SONiC Lite HCL in Feb 2026. none-announced is a checked state, not an absence.","port-leds":"photo+HIG - each RJ45 jack carries ONE integrated lamp in its outer corner (top-left on the top row, bottom-left on the bottom row), mode-switched between LNK/SPD and PoE status by the front-panel Mode button (HIG front panel LED table). Before the RJ45 sweep std/rj45-ganged drew the opening only and the lamps, sitting INSIDE the jack apertures, were not drawn - same treatment as the MX150's in-jack lamps. They now draw as led-a/led-b of common/rj45-ganged-eth@1 on the ge-poe group (both corners modelled at component default vocabulary; the mode-switched single-lamp behaviour the hardware actually has is not separately captured here). The SFP+ ports' lamps sit in the centre band between the cage rows (one \u25b2\u25bc pair per column, upper/lower port) and are drawn with common/sfp-led-pair, states overridden to the mode-switched vocabulary because the component default cites another device's guide.","port-numbering":"HIG Port Overview table: 'Port ID 0~47 RJ45 ... 48~55 SFP+', and the printed strip under each column pair reads '\u25b2n n+1\u25bc' (even numbers top row, odd bottom). HIG Figure 8 draws large per-jack numerals as a schematic aid; the photographs show NO numerals on the ganged shells - the real device numbers its ports only on the strip below the field, so only the strip is modelled (guide art vs real device: the real device wins).","power":"datasheet gives 'Typical power: 80 Watts (no transceiver)'. The HIG Connecting Power section gives the maxima: 'The maximum system power consumption is 145 watts without PoE enabled, and 1517 watts with PoE enabled', with the testing criteria printed beside them - 45C ambient, optics fully populated, 100% traffic load - hence power-envelope: fully-configured. power-max-w carries the PoE-enabled 1517; the no-PoE 145 is kept as power-max-no-poe-w because the two describe the same box with and without its defining feature loaded. The PoE budget is stated three times as 820 W (802.3at 30 W or 802.3af 15.4 W per port). The vendor qualifies all of these; nothing here is an unqualified reading.","psu-fru":"ufispace/psu-921-ac@1 built for this device from the HIG Fig 6 drawing, Component Physical Information table and the rear photograph; the fan FRU reuses ufispace/fan-402825@1 (S9510-28DC family) - the datasheet orders FAN-402825-HDN where the S9510 orders -HD, same drawn 51.5 x 42.2 face, and the configuration overrides the model attr. The S6301 photo shows the fan status lamp low on the right strip where the component draws it top-left - a skin-level delta on a shared part, recorded here and left","rear-layout":"drawing - HIG Figure 7 rear strip (1391 x 143 px, aspect 10.11 vs true 10.05, 0.6% out, 3.15 px/mm): grounding column at the left edge (two M4 holes at (6.2, 7.6) and (6.2, 24.4) with the earth symbol below - one of the HIG's two lug locations, Figure 21), fan bays at x 13.7 and 65.9 (module faces 51.5 x 42.2 abutting), blank panel to x 277, PSU bays at x 277.2 and 360.5 (faces 73 x 40 confirmed by the red release tabs at 340.9-350.1 and 424.1-433.0), vertical 'PSU0 \u25c4'/'PSU1 \u25c4' legends on the chassis strips right of each bay. The photograph corroborates every feature. The 'FAN \u25c40'/'FAN \u25c41' texts sit ON the fan modules' own faces in both sources, not on the chassis, and the shared fan component cannot carry a per-position legend - not modelled, see gaps.","sides":"estimated - no orthographic side drawing exists; the angle photograph shows the LEFT side with the front bracket screw holes and rear rail holes, and positions are estimated from it against the HIG accessory dimensions (bracket 88 x 43 x 20 mm with 4 M4 holes; rail 406.8 x 43 x 21 mm). AXIS CONVENTION: on the RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT; on the LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR (renderer convention). Content is otherwise symmetric hole patterns, mirrored as depth - x - width.","system-leds":"drawing - HIG Figure 8: two lamp rows above the first jack block, row 1 at y ~4.5 (SYS, FAN, PS0, PS1 at x 53.6/60.5/67.2/74.0), row 2 at y ~7.1 (LNK/SPD, POE, ID at x 53.0/66.5/73.2), lamps ~1.3 mm drawn with common/led-dot (2.0 mm, nearest part). States transcribed from the HIG section 10 front-panel LED table on each placement.","top":"drawing - HIG Figure 5 top view (D and W both dimensioned 440 mm; measured at 1.44 px/mm against them). AXIS: y = 0 is the REAR, as the figure is printed (fan handles and PSU tabs at its top edge). Four recessed finger-slot grooves at y 132/212/293/370 from the rear (the two nearer the rear span x 190-433, the two nearer the front x 10-433) plus the screw heads the figure draws. Positions to the figure's ~1 mm; groove depth not dimensioned anywhere, drawn as sink decor.","usb-version":"sources-disagree, recorded not resolved: the datasheet says '1 x USB 1.0 Type-A port', the HIG's cabling section says 'Connect the USB 2.0 A Type plug', and the accessory list ships a 'USB 3.0 cable'. The manifest carries the datasheet's line verbatim; see gaps."},"references":[{"sha256":"1e3af0fd1323ab60460c077baa81266fd1b359c22167533913ef045bd9f83c83","title":"UfiSpace S6301-56STP Hardware Installation Guide"}],"version":"2.0.4","views":{"bottom":{"empty":"Searched and not documented: no drawing or photograph of the underside exists in this device's intake.
